The EX-100-KVM-IP, a top-tier KVM over IP solution, excels in transmitting 4K video at 30Hz with virtually zero latency, making it an essential tool in professional environments. It stands out for its ability to ensure efficient, reliable performance across various settings, including corporate, educational, and specialized AV scenarios. Its advanced features cater to the needs of high-resolution displays and real-time interactions, enhancing the overall user experience in demanding and dynamic professional contexts.

This EX-100-KVM-IP delivers high-definition 4K video quality at a smooth 30 frames per second, coupled with an ultra-fast response time of less than 1 millisecond. This combination is crucial for applications that require both high visual fidelity and real-time interaction, such as video conferencing or dynamic digital signage.
Does the EX-100-KVM-IP support 4K video transmission, and at what frame rates?

Yes. The EX-100-KVM-IP supports 4K video at 3840×2160p and 4096×2160p up to 30Hz (4K@30Hz) with ultra-low latency (<1ms). It also supports 1920×1080p at 60Hz. Maximum pixel clock 300MHz and encoding rate 9Gb/s; HDCP 1.4 supported.

Mount units with the included brackets, connect the HDMI source to the encoder and the HDMI display to the decoder, link the encoder/decoder to a 1G network via RJ-45, connect 12V power, and attach USB peripherals. It’s plug-and-play with zero configuration; use DIP switches for multi-unit setups.
The product page does not explicitly state compatibility with third-party KVM switches. It supports HDMI 1.4b, HDCP 1.4, and USB 2.0 over IP, which are standard interfaces.

The inclusion of USB 2.0 over IP functionality allows for easy extension of USB devices over the network. Additionally, the integrated USB hub supports direct connection of multiple peripherals, streamlining workstation setups and enhancing user convenience in diverse settings, from office environments to interactive kiosks.

For transmission, the EX-100-KVM-IP supports point-to-point connections over a 1G network. Transmission distances vary based on the cabling type and SFP or fiber module used. Supported distances include 35m (115ft), 40m (131ft), 70m (230ft), 100m (328ft), and up to 300m (984ft). For exact distance mappings and cabling requirements, refer to the product specifications and documentation.
